test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below show the runs scored by 5 batsmen in a cricket match. Total runs scored by these batsmen are 500. Runs scored by a batsman is shown as a percentage of runs scored by all these five batsmen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f25ba7c77628496f4cd0a6123935fa0a7cb89a4428c776b87338cbed7ffc839b.png] 

How many runs are scored by the batsman R?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total runs = 500

Runs scored by R = 32% = 32/100 × 500

⇒ 160

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
